adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the `Calendar` interface to `createEvent(event, credentialId)` and updates GoogleCalendarService accordingly, but Office365CalendarService and LarkCalendarService still define `createEvent(event: CalendarEvent)` and select the calendar via `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []`, i.e., always the first destination calendar. With the new `destinationCalendar: DestinationCalendar[]` and the new multi-destination creation loop in `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` (iterating over `event.destinationCalendar` and calling `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`), these implementers are not credentialId-aware and can create events in the wrong external calendar when multiple destination calendars exist. TypeScript will not necessarily error on the arity mismatch, so this can slip through without `tsc` catching it.
